adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `sendAddGuestsEmails` (packages/emails/email-manager.ts) the code builds an `emailsToSend` array of `sendEmail(...)` promises and then awaits `Promise.all(emailsToSend)`. This does indeed reject on the first failing promise, preventing per-recipient visibility/partial success handling. However, the finding’s extra claim about `sendEmail` "rejects with undefined from console.error" is not shown in this diff, so only the fail-fast/observability aspect is verifiable here and is more of a robustness concern than a definite defect.
